summaries.n-nvidia-ceo-scandal: Coins named for the Nvidia CEO story. The New York Times posted on X on 2026-11-08 that Nvidia opened an investigation into its CEO Jensen Huang after he acknowledged to the board a relationship with a business executive whom U.S. intelligence determined to be a Chinese spy. On 2026-11-11 at 22:44 UTC The Wall Street Journal posted that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Huang after two extramarital affairs; a post citing Bloomberg says the company is working with an outside firm to find a new CEO, and Polymarket posted that Huang's daughter Madison Huang leads its market on the next CEO (other posts put her at 12%; Nvidia has not named a successor). Five coins are measured: two named The Nvidia Spy (Pump.fun and LaunchLab, symbol Alice), Jensen Huang Coin, Jensen Hung, and Next CEO of NVIDIA (symbol Madison), whose description repeats the Polymarket post. Dates from Codex: the Pump.fun Nvidia Spy pool opened on 2026-11-07, before the Times post; the LaunchLab one on 2026-11-08, nine minutes after it; Jensen Huang Coin and Jensen Hung on 2026-11-09; Next CEO of NVIDIA on 2026-11-12 at 05:58 UTC, about seven hours after the Journal's post. Allegations are as reported in the posts and not verified here. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Nvidia, Jensen Huang, Madison Huang or anyone in the story. Measured: five coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-gta6-dacity-coin: Coins named for Dacity Coin and AudaCity, a fictional coin brand that posts say appears in Grand Theft Auto VI material. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 posted that a GTA 6 leak shows a meme coin called "Dacity Coin"; the first Dacity Coin on Pump.fun was created 35 seconds later. On 2026-11-10 at 13:59 UTC Rockstar posted a pre-load trailer; its post does not name the coin, and posts since then say AudaCity boxes, a billboard and DacityCoin appear in Rockstar's footage and argue over which coin is the "right" one. Ten coins are measured. Seven are on Pump.fun: Dacity Coin (token created 2026-10-11), DacityCoin and AudaCity (2026-10-15), a second DacityCoin with the symbol DACITY (pool opened 2026-10-15), DacityCoin with the symbol DTC (2026-10-20), DacityCoin with the symbol DAC (2026-10-24) and GTAVI AudaCity (2026-11-10 19:03 UTC, after the trailer), whose description reads "There's a meme coin in GTA 6 called \"Dacity Coin\" in the new leak." Three are copies named AudaCity that opened on Meteora DBC on 2026-11-12 between 04:18 and 04:40 UTC, hours before this run. Most have empty or unrelated descriptions, so their names carry the claim. What the footage shows was not checked here, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two. Measured: ten coins across all their pools.
